issues: The EX area cost reduction is incorrectly unconditional. Encode the Overflow requirement so the chosen Wyrmkin follower costs 3 less only if Overflow is active for you.

Missing 'When this card is discarded, you may put it into your EX area.' It should be an onDiscard ability that optionally moves this card to your EX area; implement support for an onDiscard ability using moveSourceToExArea behind an optional wrapper if needed.
Missing 'At the start of your end phase, give your leader [defense]+1.' It should be a startOfEnd ability with healLeader amount 1.

Missing continuous ability 'While there's another Draconic Duelist card on your field, this follower has Storm.' It should be encoded as a passive conditional self-grant of Storm, but the engine lacks a condition for checking another allied card with a given trait/name on field; implement such a field condition and encode grantKeyword storm to self under it.

Missing restriction 'This card can't be played during your turn.' The spell effect itself is correct, but encode a play restriction limiting it to opponent turn only; implement an ability/condition for play timing restriction by turn if not available.

The main effect is incorrectly encoded as a deck search for a follower. It should repeatedly put the top card of your deck into your EX area until your EX area is full; implement a repeat-until-full EX area operation or looped top-deck-to-EX effect.

Missing 'This turn, the next card you play that was put into your EX area this way costs 0.' It should grant a one-time play cost reduction specifically to a card moved to EX area by this spell; implement tracking for cards put into EX area by the resolving effect and a corresponding next-play cost reduction.
